title: Bring Your Own AI
description: Allow users to bring their own AI credentials, configured per user, with encrypted storage and quota awareness - while guaranteeing the platform remains fully usable with no paid API via local Ollama.
rationale: BYO-AI removes platform-side API costs, respects user choice, and unlocks higher-capability models for those who want them, without making the core product depend on paid services.
success_criteria: A user can add, rotate and remove provider keys; keys encrypted at rest
Keys are never displayed after entry and never appear in logs
The platform works end-to-end with no keys via local Ollama
Per-user usage/quota is visible to that user
notes:
## Scope (in)
- Encrypted API key storage
- Per-user provider selection and configuration
- Quota awareness
- Key management (add, rotate, remove)

## Out of scope
- The provider abstraction itself (EPIC-008)
- Generating critiques (EPIC-010)
- Billing/payments

## Dependencies
- EPIC-005 - keys and config are per authenticated user
- EPIC-008 - keys configure providers; usage tracking exists

## Assumptions
- Secrets encrypted at rest, never logged or exposed
- Platform functions with no user keys by falling back to local Ollama
- Quota awareness uses EPIC-008 usage tracking

## Risks
- Key leakage -> encrypt at rest; never render; redact logs; security review
- Encryption key management -> managed/derived key strategy; documented rotation
- Hard dependency on paid APIs creeps in -> enforce Ollama-first; CI no-keys test
- Quota overruns -> surface usage + warnings against known limits

## Future extensions
- Organisation-shared keys with pooled quota
- Per-feature provider overrides
- Hardware-backed/KMS secret storage
